reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: First rate work, neat & tidy and completely professional. Turned up every day dead on time and worked late as necessary. Removed fitting including radiator, door knobs etc. rather than paint/paste around them; and refitted later… Overall, brilliant job.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: We have asked Chris back to do various decorating jobs over many years. Genuinely delighted with all his work. Chris is everything you could ask for in a tradesman - helpful, reliable and a good communicator. Very happy to recommend him.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Chris recently completed redecorating my sitting room which has a very high ceiling and had unsightly cracks in the plaster. He is meticulous and methodical in his preparation, takes great care in covering and protecting furniture and flooring, etc and I am delighted with the end result…
items.label: Which? review
